2742.title: Project composer navigation shows a legacy-route skeleton
2742.rootCauseOneLine: The project-scoped SDK action selects the project, then navigates through a legacy route that renders a full-page skeleton before it redirects to the root composer.
2742.proposedFix: Keep the project selection update and navigate directly to the root composer route with the prompt-focus state.
2742.caveats: The browser reproduction used an isolated development app and a temporary local plugin.
